name: herd-weight-audit
description: Compare every animal's current weight snapshot against its own temporal history to catch stale or anomalous readings

arguments.species: Optional filter, e.g. dairy cattle, pig

rules: current weight snapshot must equal the latest history point; otherwise flag as stale
flag if weight declined more than 10 percent over the trailing 6 months
flag if a single-month change exceeds twice the animal's own trailing 3-month average pace
template: Call {{tools}} for every entity matching species={{species}}, picking {{pick}}. Compare {{trendCheck}} current value against its own history, from the same tool list, for the same attribute. Apply rules: {{rules}}. Report entity id, name, and the specific values and dates for every rule violation.
